tei:div.tei:p: ji ga po rjo(/sa 〉nga
ri
(104)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

zlagrad/ 1zloskyi (1༷ 4)1142 gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags dang snying po byin rlabs can rnams phyogs gcig tu rin po che bu ston pas bkod pa stod na bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum mang po dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ 3dus 'khor rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 3dus 'khor 'gro lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 4sbyor drug gi brgyud pa/ 5dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug gi brgyud pa/ 5lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa/ 5pad+ma lam gyi brgyud pa/ 6nā ro chos drug gi brgyud pa/ 7rdo rje phreng ba'i brgyud pa/ 8kye rdor sa lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 81

bde mchog gi brgyud pa/ 9bde mchog sdom 'byung gi brgyud pa/ 10ma hā ma pa'i brgyud pa/ 10bde mchog ral gcig gi brgyud pa/ 11tshar gsum khug pa'i brgyud pa/ 11gcod kyi nyer brgyud/ 13ha'i brgyud pa/ 13gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 13gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi brgyud pa/ 14bde mchog nag po ba'i brgyud pa/ 15bde mchog paṇa chen ma'i brgyud pa/ 15rdo rje gdan bzhi'i brgyud pa/ 16gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i brgyud pa/ 16dgra nag gi brgyud pa/ 17tshe dpag med kyi brgyud pa/ 17sgrol ma btsun ma'i brgyud pa/ 18bdag med ma rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 18rnal 'byor ma paṇa chen lugs kyi brgyud pa/ 18rdo rje 'byung ba'i brgyud pa/ 19kun rig gi brgyud pa/ 19don zhags kyi brgyud pa/ 20rnam 'joms kyi brgyud pa/ 21rnam sras kyi brgyud pa/ 21paṇa chen gyi sdom brgyud/ 222

phar phyin gyi brgyud pa/ 22mngon pa kun btus kyi brgyud pa/ 23'bum gyi brgyud pa/ 24'dul ba mdo rtsa'i brgyud pa/ 24mkhan brgyud snga ma'i rim pa 25bstan pa gtad rabs kyi brgyud pa/ 26tshad ma rnam nges kyi brgyud pa/ 26grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i mtshan/ 27mtshan brjod kyi sngags/ 29dus 'khor gyi sngags/ 29dus 'khor 'khor lo sdom chen gyi sngags/ 44bde mchog lū i pa'i sngags/ 47rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi sngags/ 52bde mchog sdom 'byung gi sngags/ 52khrag 'thung mngon 'byung gi sngags/ 55phag mo mngon byang gi sngags/ 57mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sngags/ 59rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ 85bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sngags/ 115rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 115brtag gnyis kyi sngags/ 116rdo rje gur gyi rgyud sngags/ 118sasbu ṭa'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 122dpal ye shes snying po'i thig le'i sngags/ 1273

dpal ye shes snying po'i sngags/ 129dgyes rdor gsang mdzod kyi sngags/ 129rdo rje a ra li'i sngags/ 129ri gi a ra li'i sngags/ 129dpal gdan bzhi'i rgyud sngags/ 130rnal 'byor gdan bzhi'i sngags/ 134sangs rgyas thod pa'i sngags/ 139rdo rje bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i sngags/ 143ma hā ma ya'i sngags/ 143zla gsang thig le'i sngags/ 143sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rgyud sngags/ 149gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi sngags/ 150bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i sngags/ 154gsang 'dus rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud sngags/ 158sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sngags/ 168ral gcig ma'i rgyud sngags/ 175dgra nag gi sngags/ 176gshin rje gdong drug gi sngags/ ci 178gshed dmar gyi sngags/ 178khro bo'i gtum po'i rgyud sngags/ 181phyag rdor drag po gsum 'dul gyi sngags/ 186rnam 'byed drag po gsum 'dul gyi sngags/ 187phyag rdor gsang ba sngon bstan gyi rgyud sngags/ 190rdo rje glu gar gyi rgyud sngags/ 1964

mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud sngags/ 197mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud sngags/ 202de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 207khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags/ 249ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi sngags/ 252ngan song sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i sngags/ 257dpal mchog gi rgyud phyi ma'i sngags/ 266rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi sngags/ 272gsang ba rgyan bkod kyi sngags/ 277nor bu thig le'i sngags/ 278phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sngags/ 293dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sngags/ 322khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i gsang rgyud kyi sngags/ 351'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi sngags/ 354dpa' bo gcig grub kyi sngags/ 363'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i sngags/ 366'jam dpal gyis smod btsugs pa'i sngags/ 366'jam dpal gyis dam bcas pa'i sngags/ 367'jam dpal gyi mtshan sngags/ 367'jam dpal shes rab blo 'phel gyi sngags/ 367pad+ma dra ba'i rgyud sngags/ 367pad+ma cod paṇa gyi sngags/ 388don zhags cho ga zhib mo'i sngags/ 390don yod rgyal po'i snying po/ 3985

me lha dgugs pa'i sngags/ 399don yod zhags pa'i snying po'i sngags/ 400khro bo sgrub pa'i cho ga 402spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor na gnas pa thams cad dgugs pa/ 403me tog dbul ba/ 403spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dran par byed pa'i sngags/ 404gtor ma'i sngags/ 404mar me'i sngags/ 404khrus kyi sngags/ 405gos kyi sngags/ 405mal cha'i sngags/ 405chu'i sngags/ 405dbul ba'i sngags/ 406me tog nyid dor ba'i sngags/ 406byang sems 'gegs pa/ 406bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i sngags/ 407nye reg gi sngags/ 407tshoganod sbyin mo ral gcig ma mchod pa'i sngags/ 407las thams cad pa'i sngags/ 407yul bcings pa 408phyogs bcing ba 408me tog dbul ba/ 408grub pa don yod pa'i rig pa'i rgyal po/ 4096

don zhags dri ma med pa'i dpal gyi gzungs/ 410don zhags kyi gzungs/ 424seṅge'i sgra'i gzungs dang phan yon dang rtog sngags/ 428don zhags kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po'i cho ga'i sngags/ 431thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher rdzogs pa'i sngags/ 431bcu gcig zhal gyi sngags/ 436'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa'i rgyud sngags/ 436'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sngags/ 437nī la kur+sā'i sngags/ 438spyan ras gzigs ha ya spyi ba'i gzungs/ 440'phags pa me kha la'i gzungs/ 442snying rjes mi bshol ba zhes bya ba'i sngags/ 444spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gyi gzungs/ 444spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po/ 445seṅge'i sgra'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 445spyan ras gzigs seṅge'i sgra'i gzungs/ 446rje btsun seṅge'i sgra'i gzungs/ 446rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ 447legs grub kyi rgyud sngags/ 477phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi sngags/ 479phyag rdor 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sngags/ 480'jig rten gsum 'dul gyi sngags/ 485gos sngon can gyi sngags/ 486khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags/ 4877

rmi lam mthong ba'i sngags/ 487gnod sbyin drag po lag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgyad pa/ 487rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sngags/ 488rdo rje mchu'i sngags/ goXganam lcags kyi mchu'i sngags/ 495'phags pa lcags mchu'i sngags/ 496'phags pa lcags mchu/ 497lcags mchu nag po/ 497rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags/ ga7rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i sngags/ gnardo rje bcu'i snying po/ dzinardo rje sa 'og gi rgyud kyi rgyal po'i sngags/ 499phyag rdor gos sngon can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud sngags/ 503rdo rje bde khros kyi rgyud sngags/ 507rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i sngags/ 507dpal gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 508dpal gtum po'i rgyud phyi ma'i sngags/ 510mi g.yo ba'i gsang rgyud kyi sngags/ 512mi g.yo ba'i stobs dpag tu med pa'i rtog pa/ 512'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa'i rgyud sngags/ 516'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sngags/ 518khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 524'phags pa khro bo'i rgyal po rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 524stobs po che'i sngags/ 528

mchod pa'i sprin gyi sngags/ 534'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags/ 534'phags pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags/ 535khro bo'i rgyal po smre brtsegs la bstod pa'i sngags/ 536'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i sngags/ 536sgrol ma las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud sngags/ 537sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 543'phags ma sgrol ma'i sngags/ 544sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa'i sngags/ 544sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sngags/ 544'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i sngags/ 545sgrol ma ku ru ku l+le'i rtog pa'i rgyud sngags/ 545stong chen rab 'joms kyi sngags/ 545rma bya chen mo'i sngags/ 5goso sor 'brang ma'i sngags/ 562bsil ba tshal gyi sngags/ 569gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i sngags/ 571rnam rgyal gyi snying po/ 572ngan 'gro sbyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sngags/ 572lha'i dbang po gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sngags/ 573gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa chung ba/ 574gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi sngags/ 576gtsug tor mchog grub ma'i sngags/ 579gtsug tor gdugs dkar gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags/ 5819

gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags/ 583kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba'i sngags/ 585'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sngags/ 586gtsug tor can gyi rtog pa'i sngags/ 586'od zer 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyung ba'i rtog pa'i rgyal po rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs pa/ 587skya ma'i ming lha mo 'od zer can 'byung ba'i rgyud sngags/ 589'phags pa par+ṇa sha ba ri'i sngags/ 592'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sngags/ 592'phags pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi rtog pa'i sngags/ 593'phags ma lha mo bskul byed ma'i sngags/ 596'phags pa dug sel gyi sngags/ 596'phags pa dbyig dang ldan pa'i sngags/ 597'phags pa grags ldan ma'i sngags/ 597rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can gyi sngags/ 598lha mo brgyad kyi sngags/ 601rig sngags kyi rgyal mo sgrol ma mchog gi sngags/ 602rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya'i yang snying gi sngags/ 603so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i sngags/ 603rma bya chen mo'i snying po/ 604stong chen rab 'joms kyi smon lam gyi sngags/ 604klags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma sor mo can ma rig pa'i rgyal mo/ 60410

gza' yum gyi sngags/ 605gza'i yum/ 606shes pa mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten gyi sngags/ 607bi ma la utā ṣa'i sngags/ 607'phags pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i sngags/ 608rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po/ 608rab tu gnas pa mdor bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi sngags/ 608nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi sngags/ 609rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ 611tshe dpag med kyi snying po'i sngags/ 611tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo'i sngags/ 611tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snying po'i sngags/ 612rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngags/ 613rgyal ba'i bla ma'i sngags/ 613las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags/ 613bde ldan gyi sngags/ 613'phags pa sa'i snying po'i sngags/ 614sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i sngags kyi rnam grangs/ 614sangs rgyas yan lag dang ldan pa'i sngags/ 615rgyal chen bzhis smras pa/ 615'phags pa rgyal ba can gyi sngags/ 615bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyi sngags/ 617snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i sngags/ 617zla ba'i 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i sngags/ 61811

de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po rjes dran/ 618sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ 618'phags pa dri ma med pa'i sngags/ 618'phags pa khyad par can gyi sngags/ 619sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 621spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 621byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 621nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 621kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 622phyag na rdo rje'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 622'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 622sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 623sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 623byams pas dam bcas pa'i sngags/ 624'phags pa gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags/ 624byang chub rgyan 'bum gyi sngags/ 624gsang ba ring bsrel gyi sngags/ 625mchod rten gcig btab na bye ba btab par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ 625'phags pa lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa'i sngags/ 626'phags pa sgo bzang po'i sngags/ 627'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sngags/ 630tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i sngags/ 631sgo drug pa'i sngags/ 63112

'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags/ 631'phags pa gser can gyi sngags/ 632snying rje mchog gi sngags/ 633'phags pa gzungs chen po/ 633rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sngags/ 634'phags pa sa'i dbang po'i sngags/ 636'phags pa be con chen po'i sngags/ 636gtsug gi nor bu'i sngags/ 638tsan+dan gyi yan lag gi sngags/ 639phyir bzlog rnam par rgyal ba can gyi sngags/ 639mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i sngags/ 640gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phreng ba'i sngags/ 641gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i sngags/ 641'phags pa gdon mi za ba'i sngags/ 642gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sngags/ 642thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i sngags/ 642'phags pa dbang bskur ba'i sngags/ 643'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags/ 643bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i sngags/ 643'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i sngags/ 644mchod pa'i sprin gyi sngags/ 644phyag bya ba'i sngags/ 645bstod pa brjod pa'i sngags/ 645mchod sprin 'byung ba'i sngags/ 64513

yon tan dpag tu med pa'i sngags/ 645'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yum gyi sngags/ 645phyir bzlog stobs can gyi sngags/ 646dbugs chen po'i sngags/ 646'phags pa ye shes ta la la'i sngags/ 646ye shes ta la la'i sngags/ 647'od zer dri ma med pa'i sngags/ 647gar mkhan mchog gi sngags/ 649nor bu bzang po'i sngags/ 655nor bu bzang po'i rtog pa'i sngags/ 655'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po'i rtog pa'i sngags/ 664'phags pa gnod 'dzin dpal gyi sngags/ 667gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi sngags/ 668tshogs bdag gi rgyud sngags/ 668tshogs bdag gi snying po/ 668nor rgyun ma'i sngags/ 669nag po chen po'i rgyud sngags/ 670nag po chen po'i sngags/ 670lha mo nag mo'i sngags/ 670nag po chen po'i gzungs rims zhi byed/ 671dpal lha mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 672lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa'i sngags/ 672dpal chen mo'i mdo'i sngags/ 672'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo/ 67314

bar du gcod pa sel ba'i rig sngags/ 673lha mo chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa'i sngags/ 673ro langs bdun pa'i sngags/ 673gtsug tor 'bar ba'i sngags/ 675shes rab bskyed pa'i sngags/ 675thos pa 'dzin pa'i sngags/ 675shes rab bskyed par byed pa'i sngags/ 676shes rab bskyed pa'i sngags/ 676blo ka brgya lobs par 'gyur ba'i sngags/ 676sh+lau ka brgya 'dzin pa'i sngags/ 676blo ka stong lobs pa'i sngags/ 677sh+lau ka stong lobs pa'i sngags/ 677sh+lau ka nyis stong lobs pa'i sngags/ 677blo ka sum stong lobs pa'i sngags/ 677mi brjed pa'i sngags/ 677stong 'gyur gyi sngags/ 678thos pa 'dzin pa'i sngags/ 678yon yongs su sbyong ba'i sngags/ 678phyag bya ba'i sngags/ 678gos brgya thob pa'i sngags/ 679bdag bsrung ba'i sngags/ 679yid du 'ong ba'i sngags/ 679sdig pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 679snang ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 68015

sman la gdab pa'i sngags/ 680bskor ba'i sngags/ 680mchod rten la bskor ba byed pa'i sngags/ 680yon sbyong ba'i sngags/ 680tshig btsan pa'i sngags/ 681khros pa zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 681khros pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 681rin po che brdar ba'i sngags/ 681pad+ma'i spyan gyi sngags/ 681ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i sngags/ 682skran zhi ba'i sngags/ 682ma zhu ba'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 682bad kun gyi nad sel ba'i sngags/ 682k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ 682rims nad rab tu zhi byed kyi sngags/ 683mig nad rab tu zhi ba'i sngags/ 683'phags pa rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa'i sngags/ 683sman la gdab pa'i sngags/ 683mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa be+e ḍūr+ya'i sngags/ 683mchog thob pa'i sngags/ 684sman gtong ba'i tshe sman la gdab pa'i sngags/ 684gzhang 'brum zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 684'brum bu'i nad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 685rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ 68516

sa ma ya a nu sma ra/ badz+ra dha ra ba tsā nā ñtsahu/ mār ma ṇi ni krin ②ta hūṃ/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ru tu ru/ hu ru hu ru/phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kṛ tān ④tā ya/ de ba ṛ shri ༷bi dā pa ṇa ⑤ka rā rjo ya ha na ①ha na dudaṇa ḍi na swā hā// //na maḥs man ta bus rnal/ o hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ u gra shu la pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ o byo ti nir nā da hūm̐ rtsu hūm̐/ o o o 0phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa / o ma hā ba lā 0ya swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud dhā rna/ ṭak+ki 8rgyu dza8/na maḥs man ta bud dhā rna0/ a tsa la kā ra 7ṇa tsan ḍabya/ nas nas0/mas mas/ mos moskyo/ sasna saskyo/ tab tab/ ha ha/8 ta na ta na/ da ha da ha/ mo ⑩ha mo ha/ mo ha ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badz+ra hā sa ku ru/ ha sa ha tsho —9sa/ mar da tshur ṭa mar da phyir ṭa/ gadz+dza gadz+dza/ ha na ha na/ ban dha ban dha/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha a 0bi sha ma hā man tra pā la ka phyi /dhu na dhu na / ti ṇi ti ṇi/ khā da khā tsod/ bi gha nān mā ra ya mā ra ya/ duṣ+ṭan bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa / sasban tsoku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi ṣa ma badz+ra sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ tri ba li ⑩ta raṃ ga nar ta 16) / māṃ māṃ rmā rdzi/ hṝ hṝ tsā/ a tsa la tse snyenaṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūṃ hūm̐ rgyu⑥/ a sa man ti kuṭa ṭa sum hā ba la sha tā gi ya/ pa ra maṇ+ḍanacha/ i i nye/ tsā tsā/ mi shud : 0tu lo ka tu ṣ+yo tu brdzun ri mosta tshon/ a bra ti ha ta ba le bh+yaḥdz+wa ()la ya tāṭa/ a sa ha na maḥswā hā / / //o sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ gro'i pa ya grihā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga ba 8 stan bit+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shu li (7ni swā hā/ na maḥs man ta bud dhā rmā/104—172

simyaka ① bud dha ko ṭī nān/ tad ya thā/ o tsa le tsu le tsun de swā hā/ o bha ya nā shā ②ni tā sa ni tā se/ tā sa ya tā sa ya be+e ra ṭi phroṃ niku ṭi ta duṭi/ tā ḍi ⑤be tā ḍi0/ shwe te shwe te/ dzā aṭi ni niswā hā/ o gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/sasba duglen phaṭa phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā po phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/badz+ra tī la/ badz+ra dha ro 0ādzñā pa ya ti/ kā ⑩ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra/ tī la ya hūm̐ r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ o tshin da tshin da0/ 8ra 'ad 8ha ra dīsta badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa // //o badz+ra rā dza r+ghaṃ/ o tri o byurgyu tsobaḥtso/ o mā rī rtsu de pa ta ⑩le swā hā/o ma hā sa ha sra pra marta tson ba ra sid dhi da sbo yige ma ṇi bu badzā 0ṇi rtsu phaṭa swā hā/o bha ga bā 3khri dh+wa dzā gra ke yu re pa rī sre bzhu/ bi dh+wa nas na kā swā ④si n+ya ba ri la ni / u lū ⑤kā mu khi / kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ba rā 0sri n+ya ma/ a nan ta bhu dze/ a nan ta mu khe pra ha ra pra ha ra/ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ o ma ṇi dha ri brdzu 0ṇi ma hā pra ti sā ri ṇi zhug hā/ o ba su dha ri ma hā ba su dha ra brijini ba ⑥ ta ni ba su swā hā// //a (trere du tri (nyeni pra ku pa ta tsan khezhuge/ ma hā be ga dha ri bed dhu dzi tre(ste/ma ho da ri/ ro tri ga pā lā mā la/ dha ⑥ri ṇi dza ṭa ma dubaku ṭa/ man ti te⑩/nā nā pra ha ra ṇa dha ri hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ ku ru ku ru/ hūm̐ hūṃ/ bra ma dha mtha/ sasba sha r+ghaṃ (rtenān/ sho ni ta bi ba/ pra tsaṇa te4nya/ be ga dha ri/ pa tsa ta pa tsa ta/ bi ki ra ta/ sā dha (nyeya r+ghaṃ/da ha da ha/ sab sha t+t+waṃ/ sab duṣ+ṭan/ ni krin (geta/ pra sā dha rigeya hūm̐/ ma hā bha ga 8bha ga ba (nyete/ dz+wa la dz+wa (nyal r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ me ba sha nā ya swā hā// //rgo 104—173

oṃ ha ri s+t+ya ma hā yak+ṣa tsā yel/ ha ra ha ra/ sab yak+ṣi ṇi pra be sha ni swā hā// //o bi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba ②ri/ sabhā mā ②ra bra sha ma ṇi dus phaṭa/ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇa ḍa dur ṇadu/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sab ⑦budha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā/ nād swa bhā be ta ⑧badz+ra dharma hri ⑨da ya/ a ba sho dha ni ⑩/ hūṃ hūm̐/ o a nud ⑩ta ra sab 'gyu dza me gha 0ud ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i tsomo/ga ga na kai 8rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ o r+ghaṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa0/ bha k+ṣa ya thā tshuphaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī a mu ka su rag ta yi.ā kur ṣa tsa ya yiya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sum+bha badz+ra mu sa ⑥len / tsuṇ+ḍi ya na ra lhag gha 0rtsu phaṭa/ o badz+ra nā rā ya ṇadu/ nir ba bā yas/bam mu me ge hūm̐/ o ma hā pu ka badz+ra/ dz+dza ④rgyu bur duṭa ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra i gu ⑩sha a 0kar ṣa ya hūṃ/ o badz+ra pā sha ban dha rtsu/ o badz+ra ṭak+ki durā dzā ya hūm̐/ o badz+ra mus tsaṇ+ḍa 0rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra mu 0khri la ya 0 / o badz+ra mud gar ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ// //o āḥ// na maḥs man tā 9rna/ samyaka dusam bud dha cis ṭī dunān/tad ya thā/ o tsa le tsu le tsun de swā hā/ oṃ bha ga ba tī tsun de rdu rdu phroṃ phroṃ/mṛ mṛ/ ru ru/ sru sru/ ru ru/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi/ ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/gro: pa ya gro: pa ya/ sa ra sabya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ha ra ha ra/ bhañdza bhañdza/ma ra ma ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ pa tsa pa tsa/ da ha da ha/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍa/ sang sh+yiba'i gdon dang / rims zhag gcig pa dang / zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang / zhag bzhi pa dang / rtag pa'i rims dang / yud tsam tsodang /'byung po dang / ro langs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum gyi gdon dang / mngal nas skyes pa dang / las las skyes pa 'gro ba dang /104—174

gnas pa 'di dag dang sdang ba gang dag /sbyin pa'i bdag po la 'tshe ba thams cad / sā dha ①ya sā dha ②ya/ mār ③da ya mār rjod ya/ sho ṣa ya/ sho ṣa ya/tā ①pa ya tā ༷pa ya/ u pa dha ya/ u pa dha ya/ ha na ha na/ badzān⑦/ sa ra sa ra/ daṇ+ḍi na/ ma ra ma ra/ kha na/ rtsu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ rtsu rtsu rtsu/ tri tri tri/o tsa le tsu le tsun de sasba lasā dha ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥs/ oṃ ag nā ⑨yi/ dri bya dri bya/ a r+pā ⑩sha ma hā shri ye/ ha ⑩bya ka bya/ ba hā 0nā ya swā hā // //8ma āḥrgyu/ oṃ/ aḥyā spyo ④rgyu/ o aḥtsosasba ta thā ga to gar+bhe badz+ra ta twa sab ②dzñā na dz+wa lnga ⑩/ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga to mā tri tsobadz+ra ta to yib ya sar baṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ aḥdubadz+ra dzñā na hūm̐ phata0/ oṃ āḥdubadzo pā ya hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ āḥbadz+ra tsakra āḥ.irgyu phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra rad na ④yi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ o āḥbadz+ra ⑤pad ma u hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/o āḥbadz+ra bi shwa e hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mo hā āḥtso phaṭaswā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra waṇ+ḍi khri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ga u hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra de tshug e r+ghaṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+raḥtsosgri ra o ⑥ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra yo ga au ⑥hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dz+wa dul i tso phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ba la āḥ.irgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū bi cha'i ka rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ o āḥbadz+ra shardo tsa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gi dha ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra sa ha tso/ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ aḥtsobadz+ra spar+sha 9pa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥdhasmyu sluya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra k+ṣe ṭa ⑥sha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a zhu lo ka k+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra i 104—175

ta su ya thā sra ra thā kur krid ①te rna ti ba ra ya thā/ a bi rū pa kai de ba dad to ⑧ya dzñā dadha ⑧ya su bāg dustam bha ⑤na ku ru lo/ o hrīḥ :ཿwi kri 0tā na na hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa④ / rgyu de ba dad 2ta mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ o hrīḥ snriḥwi kri 0tā na na rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dad ⑩ta mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ o hrīḥ:ཿ0li kri ⑩tā na na hūm̐ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dad tā 8ya tshwa dad ④te bi dwo ṣa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ o hriḥ:ཿwi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/8 ma trīḥsbyoḥ0li kri ⑩tā na na r+ghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ phaṭa de ba dad 8ta uts+tsha ta yiya rna hūṃ 0phaṭa/ o yin dra 0ya hrīḥya ma ⑤yasnriḥb 0ru ṇa ④ya 6sgo/ ṭa/ be ra pang kris/ phro/ 4/ na pa/ tā0/ yin ka tshun ye phaṭa/ na phyizirdo h+ye ⑥na / bā ya be na/ rtsa dra ye 0rgyu/ ā mar ṣa ya hūm̐ brah+ma ṇi phaṭa/ ba sum̐ 0dha ra ye phaṭa/ be+e ma tsi tri ni duswā rādu/ sarba bhū ta bh+yo hā/ ha ha hi hi/ hūm̐ hūṃ/dze tho/ phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ o ya ma rā dza bus do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya / ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣiḥyaḥyak+ṣiḥduyats+tsha ni rā ma yabu// //o tsar tsi kye sid dha/ dra na dul ha ri ṇi rad na (nyesdo ya a pa ka ri che0/ru dhi ra ā kur ṣa ya dzaḥ0 o badz+ra go ṇi gi ṇi su 4nyebadz+ra mā ma tī bha raX/ si bha ra si bha ra tre 9tu ka mdusbyi/ ā kur ṣa ya dzaḥ.o pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā bar ta 9ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa 0la/ me da brta 0ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud dhi brta ni 9swā hā/ o ā kur ṣa ni ༷ā kur ṣa ṇi gi rī trī duṣ+ṭa ya duṣ+ṭa ru )ya shu kram/ ā kur ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ0rgyu rtsu hūm̐ swā hā/ o shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād ma ko rtazhu/ ā+oṃ sgo pā dza badz+ra swa bha ba ād ma ko rtas/ oṃ dharma dugen+d+ra tu badz+ra/ swa sabhā ba ād ma ko rtazhu/oṃ hrīḥdz+dzaḥ4nya'i kri (17 nan hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha hāḥ4nyi tī/ hu hū/ ha hai/ho ho(ste/ haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ sdo bud+dha ḍa snyo kyi nī/ oṃ rad na ④104—177

ḍā ki nī/ oṃ dharma ḍa ①kyi nī oṃ kurma ḍa ②kyi nī lo rna gi mi oṃ mud ga rā ②dzaḥ.i dha dā dus/ oṃ pad ma bam̐/ oṃ khan hoḥkhru/ oṃ ā ka dusha tsa ra badz+ra ḍā ki nī swā hā/oṃ sum̐ sum̐ sum̐/ hi hi hi/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sman 0dhasmyu tsā ār+ya nud ⑧ na spyad ⑨ma aḥ0rgyu / oṃ e ka dza ṭī ⑩ba sum̐ tsodha ra ṇi swā hā/ oṃ puk+ka 0si oṃ// //8ma hrīḥ :ཿwi kri ⑩tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dzi na dzigatso /o rat+na lhaka8 /oṃ a ro lig ma mra dzñā sgrika8 /oṃ lo tsa ni yis/ nā byam tī tsā0/ baṇ+ḍa dur 0hrīḥbyatā ra dusaḥdu.o badz+ra dhū pa⑥/ oṃ badz+ra put+paX/ oṃ badz+ra dī pa⑥/ o badz+ra garnye/ o badz+ra i ku sha dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sbo ṭa baṃ/o badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ/ o sasba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa 0ṅgā ba ād ma ko rta0/ o sab duta thā ga ta bāka 9badz+ra swa bhā ba ād ma ko rtacha/ o sarba ⑥ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa phyaṅgā ba ād ma ko rta9/ phye bha na ku ru lo swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥ snriḥwi kri 0tā nān hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ hi hi hi hūm̐/ za dzobya/ oṃ hrīḥ :ཿwi kri 0tānan hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sa ༷shrī/ rtsu dz+wa 9la ro dz+wa ④la hūṃ/ o e h+ya 9gyi ma hā bhū ta de pa ri shi 'di dza sat+ta byam kṛ ha byatā a rtswa 0ti ā zhu ha 0ro a smo si ni hi to bha ba// //0i shu n+ya ta 631 na badz+ra ④su bhā ba ād ma ko rta9/ yaṃ ram̐ baṃ lo/ oṃ hrīḥ :ཿwi kri 65tā na na rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hre ṭ+wāṃ zhuk+ṣa yo ka rā ya/ griṇ+ḍa 'groṇ+ḍi hūṃ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ye ma hā dur dran ta da ma 0nā sha ya nā sha ya/ bi tā ⑩pa ya pi tra 0pa ya/ hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de ṣa ra 104—178

ti nu ṭa tru ṭa tru ṭa ①rgyu dzaḥswā hā/ o mo hā na ta krita ②rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ o pi shu ā+oṃ ta kṛta rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rā dugān ta krita dus rtsu phaṭa/ o khrir can ta krita ⑤rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo hā dur ti rgyu dzaḥ.i bi shu na ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.o rā ga ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.o zhir ṣ+ka ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.o mar me mar mā bi ghā ⑦te/ o badz+ra tsar tsi khyake ha ra ha ra puk+ka mā ra ya ⑨dzaḥ.o sto ṇi su gho ṇi badz+ra mā ma tī/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra si bha ra hūm̐ dzaḥ.o mar me mar ma k+ṣa ⑩bha tsā yis ra swa tiX/ da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra pha ra pha ra/ kai pa kai patso/ dhu na dhu na hūm̐ dzāḥtsom gardzi re badz+ra kur ti ke gha gha/rak+ta sho ṇi ta byasri ye kau 0ri ⑩le 8dzaḥ// //oṃ hrīḥ:ཿཿwi kri dutā na na rtsu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 0shī ti rku duru na maḥ.i hrīḥ:ཿduwi kri ④tā na na hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dupuṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ boṣaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥ:ཿduwi kri ⑩tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ 9puji ⑥ku ru boṣaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥ:ཿ0li kri 0tā na na r+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hoḥswā hā/ dum hrīḥ(29wi kri ④tā na na hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/boṣaṭa / oṃ hrīḥdhīḥduli kri ⑩tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa hrī0/ snyom hrīḥstoḥ0ci kri 0tā na na r+ghaṃ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa 4)dzaḥ.i trīḥ:ཿ(1wi kri ()tā na na hūm̐ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa lo (9swā hā/oṃ hrīḥ(29wi kri ⑩tā na na rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa/ lti bha rna ku ru lo/ byam trīḥ(29wi kri 97 na na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐/ 0i māṃ stoḥwi kri 0tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ phaṭa 0mā ra ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥ(29wi kri ④tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhum hrīḥsbyoḥ0li kri 0tā na na hūṃ rtsu phaṭa/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dum badz+ra tsar tsi ke si dha 0na tra ⑩nā la hā ri ṇi rat+na 0sdo yā ba dhiri r+ṇa ru dhi ra mā kur ṣa ya dzaḥ.i storje suphorte badz+ra mā ma kedhi/ bha ra bha ra/ sam bha ra sam bha ra/ tre+e dhā tu ka ④mā dhibyā kur ṣa ya dzaḥ.i pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā bar ta ⑩ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā bar ta 0ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/104wa 179

asna ye na maḥ.ā/ rna reju na ②maḥlan/ bha ya be na maḥdun/ tsan+d+ra ya na maḥrgyu / aska 0ya na maḥdus/ brah+ma stiṇi na maḥniphaṭa/ bsri dhar ye na maḥ0phaṭa/bai ma tsi tri ṇi na maḥ0swā/ sarba ⑩zla te bh+yo na maḥ7tā/ hi hi nyi8/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/pho dze pho/ hā 78/ he he hebya/ ho ho/ hūm̐ hūṃ/ bi sadz+dza ye ta/⑩ a āḥ0kutso / ku ru mā ra yiya/ muts+tsha ṭā duya/ ba shī 0ku ru/ bi de phyog ya/ shān+ti 3ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi phyaku ru/ o bi kri dutā na na haṃ duhā hiḥhoḥ0rtsu hūm̐/ he hihū/ ho haḥ0swā hā/ maḥr+sā ṭā ⑥kyi nī o badz+ra ṭā 0ska nī/ du.o rab ṭā ⑥kyi nī o pad+ma ṭā kyi nī o kurma ṭā ki nī ḍā tī ṇi 0rmā shrī nī ṭ+wāṃ/ o mud ka rā dzāḥtsom rda ḍa tsos/ o pad+ma bam/ oṃ khaḍa ga ho/ oṃ ā kā sha tsar badz+ra ḍā kinī 0swā hā/ dum a kā ro mu khaṃ sab dhasmyu ḍā mā bya nud 0po na tadabya/ o āḥ0rtsu/ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ8swā hā// //0i shrī tsaṇ+ḍa byam hā ro ṣa na byasasba byas pa ri lngar sa hi ta/ ā gats+tsha āg dzaḥ0rgyu baṃ hoḥ8/ a ṭa maṇ+ḍa le/ a dhijo na ⑥ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ o thi: 0tsa la pu/ pra tī ts+tsha rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ shwe tā tsa la pus pra ti ats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ o bī zhutā tsa la 0pus pra tī ts+tsha rgyu phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ rak+ta tsa la pu/ pra ti its+tsha rgyu phaṭa swā hā/o byā mā ④tsal pus pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de ṣa brdzu pus pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/o mo hā byabardzu pus pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi 0shun brdzu pus pra tī ts+tsha rtsu phaṭa/ o 'og bsgyu pus pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ zhiragyi ru)badzī pus pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dī paṃ/dhū paṃ/ gasto/ ne+e be rngu// //oṃ sab ta thā ga tā a gyi tsoge ka tsos ma ya shri ye hūm̐// //oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ā bi sha 4)a su hri 4nyed ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha na ha na/ mā 104—181

ni / bhin+da bhin+da nā ga ①mar mā ṇi/ bi 〈yon tu nā ga sha rī rā ṇi/ bi sbo ṭa ya nā ga na ya nā ni/ tad ya thā/ rgyu phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā ra ṇa ya r+ghaṃ ②phaṭa/ nā go da dusā da nā ya hūm̐ ༷phaṭa/ nī lo bā sa nā ya hūm̐ ②phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa rā kra mā ya hūm̐ ༷phaṭa/ kri ⑦〈 tā ya hūm̐ ②phaṭa/ kṛ 0rta tā r+yā pa ⑩ya hūm̐ 0phaṭa/ro ṣa ṇa ya r+ghaṃ 'phaṭa/ tā sa nā ya hūṃ 'phaṭa/ ku ṇa ḍa ud byasā da nā ya hūm̐ ⑫phaṭa / pre da ⑩mi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ tshuphaṭa/ yak+ṣa a basma tsor bi nā sha ka rā ya hūṃ yiphaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha yal/ sarba bisna 0bi nā ya ka bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ 0phaṭa/ sarba dusha rtsu si gha bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ nī lī ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā// //⑥tad ya thā/ bho bho pa nā phyinā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i rda nī lī ba ra dha ra sha rī ro/ badz+ra pā ṇi skṛ dud yo/ 0mā ti ༷kra ma tha/ mā ku lo ta dusā da 40/bha bi ṣ+pe ti0/ tad ya thā/ bud dha bud dha/ bi bud dha bi bu / mā ti kra ma thal/ ha ra ha ra/ nā gā nī/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ sarba 0nā gā nī/ dzi da : dadu / nā gā 99 da ya skyini/ bhin+da rnyin+tas/ nā ga mar mā ṇi bi shi 0tu nā ga sha rī ro 0ṇi/ bi sbo ṭa ya/ nā ga na ya na ⑥ni/ tad ya thā hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi dā phyir ṇa ya rgyu phaṭa/ nā go ta sa byad nā ya hūṃ rgyaphaṭa/ nī la bya'i byas nā ya hūṃ sh+yiphaṭa / a pra ti ha ta ba la pa bya'o kra mā ya hūm̐ 0phaṭa/ kri bya'o tā ya hūṃ 9phaṭa/kri bya 0ta tsā pā ya rtsu 0phaṭa/ ro ṣa ḍā ya hūm̐ zhuphaṭa/ tā sa nā ya r+ghaṃ 'phaṭa/ kuñdza ḍūd chasā da nā ya rtsu 'phaṭa/ pre ta bi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya r+ghaṃ 'phaṭa/yak+ṣa a pa sma char bi nā sha ka rā ya hūm̐ zhuphaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra 104wa 187

oṃ āḥrgyu/ na maḥsasba ①bus ②ma/ oṃ ra ra sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa na/ku myu ①ru ba dhā ri ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bā kye dan+da maḥbākye hūm̐/ oṃ a 0bī ra hūṃ kha 0tsa ra/ oṃ he he ku mā ra pi dhishwa ru ⑦ba tsāni/ sarba bā ⑨la bha ma shi tshuṭa ⑪pra tsobo dha ne/ e h+ye hi bha ga bam̐/ oṃ ⑩e h+ye hi ku mā ra/ shrī ḍa nud ④pa la dha ⑫ri ṇi mo ḍa la ma dhe ⑩tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa ⑩rna r+ghaṃ/ mā bi 8lo ba ku ru phaṭa swā hā// //na maḥsarba yibud+dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ā+oṃ/ oṃ sgru dhu ra dhu ra dhu ma bā si ni/ dhu mar tsi shi rgyu tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ na maḥsarba 0bud+dhā māṃ/a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nī/ tar+ya thā/ he he/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka bi shwa rū pa dha ri ⑥ṇi / arnya dusra tī ts+tsha pa ya/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha maṇ+ḍa la ma dhe dusra be sha ya bra be shadu /sarba du tā nā dun ba ka grit+na 0rgyu/ i pa ra bi ṭī ṇa tsog hā// //na maḥs mi ta bud dhā rna9/ na maḥs man+ta ga dha gu a ba bhā sa shā ⑥ yā yadu/ta thā ga tā ya/ tabya thā/ garnye gi dhe gi byā de/ gi dha na mo tedu/ pra tī ts+tsha pra tī ts+tsha mi⑥/ gi dhā dus ma tā nu tsa ri ni tsog hā// //na maḥs man+ta pud+dhā māṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nī/ na ma si ku su mi ta rā dza sum/ ta thā ga tā 0su/ tabya thā/ ku su me ku su me ku su mā tso:/ ku su ma pu (nyer bā si ni/ ku su ma ba ti swā hā// //na maḥ sarba bus kyirna/ a pra ta 0ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ tabya thā/ he he bha ga baṃ ma hā satā (nyesar+pā ba lo ki ta i mi ba li ( grisna (stepa ya grit+na bya hūm̐ sar+pā 9bi shwa sh+yir ra ṭa ṭa phaṭa 4)swā hā// //na maḥs mas 4)bud dhā nī/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ sarba 4 )ta mornya dha (nye104wa 355

māṃ lornyidhi// //na maḥs man+ta bus ②rna/ a tsi niljong bhū ④na rū r+pā rtol/ oṃ sbyo the duswā hā// //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā rmā/ a pra ti ha ta tsa ri ④shā/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ba ra de swā hā / na maḥs man+ta bur+sā nī/ a tsi sgyung niḥ ta rū r+pā tsā/ oṃ bhu ri swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nī/ a tsi stong bhu ṇita rū r+pā tsā/ oṃ tā re swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bur+sā ⑩rna/ atsi ljong bhū ta rū r+pā tsā/ tabya thā/ oṃ bi 7lo ki ni swā hā/na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nī/ a tsi stong bhū ta rū spru tsā/ tabya thā/ oṃ bi shwe bi shwe ⑫si bhā 'be bi shwa rū r+pā ṇi ka ha ༷ā be shā ā tsobe shā tsos ma ya ma nu sma ra ru ru tiṣ+ṭha swā hā// //na maḥs man+ta bur+sā ā+oṃ/ a tsi ljong bhū ⑩ta rū r+pā tsā/ oṃ shwe te shī 8ba su swā hā / na maḥs man+ta bus ā+oṃ/ a tsi ljong bhū ta rū r+pā tsā/ tabya thā/ oṃ khi khi ri khi ri r+ghaṃ khu re sarba sha rtu 8sto bha ya rdza bha 0mo ha ya ba sha mā na ya swā hā// //na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 0rna/ a pra ti ha ta shāka duti pra tsa ri zhutsā/ tabya thā/oṃ shrīḥ(sten maḥs man+ta bud+dhā dus/ sarba satwa bha tsoya pra dā phyi'i ( nyerna/ oṃ a dzi te ⑥ku mā ra rū pi ṇi e h+ye 0nyi ā gats+tsha ma ma kār+ya ma ku ru swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā rnal/ a tsi ljong bhu (nyeta rū r+pā tsā/ tabya thā/ oṃ dza ye swā hā/ du)a dzi te swā hā/a pā (nyer dzi te swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bus māṃ/ lo kā () grwa dhi ba tī (nyerna/ tabya thā / oṃ ku mā ra ma hā ku mā ra ki ṭa ki ṭa(9/ sho mu kha bo dhi satā nu tshwa ta/ ma yu 6nyerā sa na/ shāka gyuto 0dhe te bā ne/ raka rta zhe )ga ra ka rta (lhag dhā nu le ba na bra ā (ge'i(nye/ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ rmid (32/ raka ta puṣ+ka tsi (srita mū rti sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ bhā ma bhā (sgom/ bhā (nam ya bhā (shem ya/ la hu 4)la hu ma 6 )bi lo ba 104wa 357

biṣa yal/ pā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kāl/ shwe ta yarnyo ba bī ta/ rad na ma ③ku ṭa mā lā dha ra/ sasba dzha dushi ri sa kri dhita ma ⑥ku ṭa/ ma hā bhu ⑦ta/ ka ma la kri nin ka 0ta la/ rgyu na sa mā rnyi bi mo k+ṣa a pra 0kam bya/ ba hu satwa yisan ta ti ba ri ba tsa 8ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi kātso/ sasba kusmyu byab ra ṇi 'bi sho dha ka /sab byā dhi pra mo tsa ka /sarba ā shā 8pa ri pu ri 8ka / sabra satwa ma 'amā sa gtso /na mo tu te swā hā// //(gyen maḥsasba ta thā ga tā 0ār+ya ba lo kṛ dute shwa ra badz+ra dha re bh+yaḥ/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra / tsu ru tsu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kātso/ tsi ri tsi ri ba ri bi ril ma hā pad+ma ha sta/ ka la ka la/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā s+thā dum ṅgāb tatso/ tsa ra tsa ra/tsa tsa ra ti/ tsa re shwa ra/ e h+ye hi/ sidha sirgya(nye/ burgya bu tso/ dhā ba dhā bske/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ba ra ma shud dha satā0/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā ba shu ba ti be ṣa dha ra/ ha hā/ hi tī/ hu hū/ oṃ kā ra ma hā brah+ma be ṣa 0dha ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ rasmi 0sha ta sa ha sra ⑩ti maṇa ḍi ta shī rā 6)ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa dul/ ta ba ta ba/ ba sogeg banas/ so mā di t+ya/ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ pad+me na dra/ ri (me'i ga nasmyo/ de ba ga ṇa(7/abya 9tsi ta tsa ra ṇa/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sa nad 0ku mā ra/ ru dra/birgyu ba (gyes ba/ dha na da/ de ba ri ( ṣi ṇa ya ku(ste /ba hu bi bi dha be ṣa/ dha ra dha ra/ sa mas ba lo kā ste/ bi (nyalo ki te/ lo ki te shwa ra/ mu ya mu ya/muñtsa muñtsa/ rba dha bam̐ dha na/ tā ḍa ṇa(rte/ tadz+dza (nyan/ rā dza taska ra a ga ni/sud 6)ka / ba ṣi nya/ shas la 6)ri mo tsa ka /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ba la bo : ga tsa tu 104wa 402

rā r+ya sa/ t+ya sam bra kā ①sha ka /ta ma ta ma/ sa ma sa ma/ ma hā tsi t+yan dha/kā ra pra sha ma na mi li mi li/ e ṇi ②ya tsarma ②ba ri ka ra/ e gye hi/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ bi shud+dhā ④tha ṣa ya ni bā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kātso/ shwe ta la ༷rnyo ba bī ta / rad na ma ⑦ku ṭa mā lā dha ra/ sasba dzñā shi ra sa kri gta/ ka ra bu ḍa/dha ⑨na/ sa mā 0dhe/ bi mo k+ṣa a bra kum bya/ ṣa ṭa/ pā ra mi tā pa ri pu ra ṇa0la/ ba hu sa t+ya san ta ⑩ti ba ri ba 8tsa kā tsosasba mā rā di pra du ṣ+ṭa pra marnya 8ka /sab sisgru tsosha ba ri bru ra ka /a gi ṣiñtsa sasba ta thā ga ta/ a bhi ṣe kai ra/ bha ga bān ta0/ a mo gha rā dza 8rgyu phaṭa/ na mo tu 7te swā hā// //dun mo rat+na tra ya 0ya/ na ma i.ār+ya ⑥a mi ta bhā ④ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/na mo i.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ a mo gha ba ra da/ bā sha hā dusta ya/ ma hā shu ya dā ⑥ya ā gats+tsha/bha ga bān/ pad+ma hasta/ ba ra da kai ro (nyegu la / pad+ma hūṃ zhu dze ma hā ba shu ba til/ be ṣa dha re/ bra sridasgro/ shī sgro dumā gats+tsha ma hā be ga bi bā sha ta ra smi6/sa ha sra.i/ a mo gha shudhe/ sa ha sa ha/ tsa la tsa la/ ā gats+tsha/ abha ga bān ske/ a ba lo ki te/ shwa ra ma ma gan dha put+pa sam mardza ni yam pra tīts+tsha/ tri rad na sa t+ya na⑥/ a mo gha sidhe swā hā// //sgonyan mo rad na ()ā ya/ na ma ār+ya ()a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru tsā 0kā ya/ sabra gan dha dhi ba sidhaX/ a mo gha bhu dza / ba ra dha ()ya sab gan dha ma (nyelca bi bhu ṣi ta pri ye()/ tsaṇa nges 4)shi ri sra 104—403

bri yel/ gan dha gan dha nu le ba na sā ma bra tīts+tsha ba ra pa ra ba ra/ dha ra ②ya swā hā/ na mo rat+na du'i ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ hi li nyi li/ mi li mi li ma hā bra bha/ su bi ma le/ brah+ma be ṣa dha re/ su ma ti ba ra tedu/ tu ru tu ru/bi tsi tra put+pa ma dus bi bhu bya'i te/ ha ra ha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ tu ru tu ru/a mo gha hri ⑦dra ⑧ya pra mo dha ⑨na ku ru pra tī ts+tsha ma ma put+pa pa re swā hā// //tson mo rab 8tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya 8ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ma hā bo dhi satā tsob ra de/ sma ra sma ra/bha ga bān④/ sa ma ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta shā byasirnye/ bha ga bānatshu/ a ba lo ki ta0/ sasba satwa a ba lo ki na8/ a mo gha ba ti yihā sha haste/ si dusidhe ⑥si du / ba ra da sirgyan duku te/ bu dhasmra/ so gha sa h+ye na/ tu ru tu ru/sat+ya sa ma yā ba du' ya swā hā// // dun mo rab dutra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/⑦ tabya thā/ dhu re dhu re/ badz+ra dha ra/pad+ma dza be/ bi ga tā ba ra de/ be ga be ga rgya ṭu sgyu ṭu/ sabra bi dza bri yeX/bu dharma / si gha sa h+ye na/ mi li mi li swā hā// //4 7na mo rab 0sdo yā ya/ na ma ār+sha 6)ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi swatwa duya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ a bra ti ha ta/ ta thā ga tā cha1 na kā ya/104wa 404

bha ga bān①/ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ pad+mā sa na/ pad+ma bhu dze/ shwe taṅgel/ shwe ta mā l+ya ②bi bhu ༷'i te/ sgru ma rgya ma/ dz+wa la bu dharmal/ si gha sa tre na swā hā// //dun mo rajo ༷tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi swatwa ⑧ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ bi ri 0bi ri/ pad+ma bā ṇi/ ā gā 0mā ga mā0/ a mo gha tad twa sidhedhi/ sab ta thā ga ta ga ga na ra smi ⑫sanya tso di te/ sabra bi tsodha ra bi sho dha de8/ a mo gha sidhe swā hā// //tson mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ sgru me rgya me/ pad+me pad+ma ni ra bha se/ shudhi shud+dha/ ka na tsa na/ pra bhā sa bi ⑩le/ shu rā shra 8shu tsi shu tsi/shu tsi go tsa ra sidhe/ pad+ma ⑩ga ba ti/ pra bha dur ṇi swā hā// //dun mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te dushā rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ shā me shā ma ya/ shān ti me/ma ma sa t+ya (nyen ma ku ru/ shān to si me sarba bā pa shan cita shud+dha/ ka l+ya dubi ra dze / shān ti bi dza ye/ dza ya sidhe/ bha ga bān/ ār+ya a ba lo ki ta 0shwa rā ya/sa ra sa ra swā hā// //()na mo rad na dutra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ nā 0mā ka ra ṣe ṇi0/ drib ⑥104wa 405

bya dze ①lege/ dza lī ③ba ho/ dza la si k+ko bha ya na nā ga dza la so sho dha ni pad+ma sa re / pad+ma bi shu ༷pā ṇi dza le ⑤si sho dha ya/ ād duman dha ra dha ra/ sa le sa ⑦le swā hā// //⑧na mo rad na latra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya bo rnyi satā ya/sa ⑩tā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sasba satā 7gyi rta kā 0rā ya/ a mo gha ba ra pra dā ya/ sabra satā tsoman na pā na pra dā ya/ de ba nā gā da ya tsortso dzu bi dhi dha ra sa 8nu pra dā ya/ sa ka la bhu ba ne/ bhu ba na bi sho dha ni/ san+ta rba 0ya bra ba ra bi shudhe swā hā// //⑩na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te 0shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ⑩ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sab de bā su ran ma duskyi 0te/ sa ma sa man+ta pra pū ra ṇi/ sa ma gan dha bā bha dusi te/ ga ga na bi shurnyedu/ mu ka ()ti pra bhe/ dza ye bi dza ye/ dza ya nir mā myo dub na ya ti/ put+pa mā l+ya gan dha bi sho dha na / bi sho dha ya/ sarba ta thā ga tā 0bi shud dhe/ pad ma bi sho dha ni swā hā// //(rkyen mo rat+na tra yā ya na ma ā r+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ me hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ dha ri 6nya'i na dha re/ dha ra ṇi ban dhe/ brnya brnya/ shu kra bi sho dha naphyi/ shu kra mā li li 0gi ti0/ shu kra bi sho dha ni/ shudha 9bi ma le swā hā// //104wa 406

①na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ dz+wa le dz+wa ②le/ bi ma le dz+wa lo la/ pra bhā sa bi ra dza/ srur+ya ba ti/ dza ya pad+ma mā la dha re swā hā// //dun mo rad na ③tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ dza le dze ༅le/ dza la ba ti/ dza la pra bhā ba ni⑦/ nā gā nisba ⑨ba ṇi/ dib byā tso'i ri ṇi/ mi li mi li swā hā// //na mo rat+na tra yā ya na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ ri ṇi ha ra ṇi/ dzig li pog li/hi ri hi ri7/ bha ga bān na tsi 8la bra tsa la/ pra ti tiṣ+ṭha mā tsorak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma ma bud+dha / dharma si gha byas h+ye na swā hā// //8na mo rab 8tra yā ya/ na maḥsarba maṇa ḍa li ⑩ni bi chasi na de ba tā ā+oṃ/na mo bibyā de pa tā 〉tso/ sarba skal pa si nī/ sasba gal pa sid+dhā 〉bla/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya / e gye hi bha ga ba ti/ pad+ma sun dha ri/ ma hā bir+ya 0de ba ti/ tsa la tsa la / pad+ma sun da duri/ be ga ba te dusu ru su ru swā hā// //tson mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥkro dha rā dza duya/ nam ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā yal/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na maḥsabra bi dha ku la rba sha su/ tabya thā/ oṃ a mo gha hri chad ya pra bhā bi ni sarba bsnan 0pra sha ma ti/104—407

ā ha ༅rā ② ha ra pad+ma pi tho ②ba bisne/ ma ṇi ka ṇa dubi bhā sri'i ta/ ka ma la khyu rjodze / ta ra ta ra/ tā rā ya ba ra ma/ a mo gha hri med ya/ dza ye tri ne dutrasti/ba ra da bhu dze/ sma ra sma ra/ bha ga bān⑩/ sasba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru bhu ru/ prah+ma pe ṣa dha ra/ bi bhū ti'i ta ta nu/ ma hā bha ya ha bha ya ha re/ ā 8lo ka ⑩ya/ bi lo ka ya/ sarba satā tsob lo ka ni ba ra ba ra de swā hā// //tson mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ ma ra ma ra sa ra sa ra/brnya brta/ sa marnyen/ a mo gha pā sha ha ste/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bu dharma ⑩ gha sad tre ⑩na swā hā// // tson mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi yisatā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ din duban dha ni0/ a mo ghi/a pri ta duha te/ mu ru mu ru/ su ru su ru/ tu ru tu ru/ sarba bisnan bi nā sha ni pad+ma sa ra bi bhu du'i te/ bu dharma bya gha sa tre dun ban dha/ a dzi ta ba ra de swā hā// //dun mo rab ③tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo rnyi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li si ri si ri/ pi ri bi ri/ ba ra ba ra/ pra ba ra bi mā na dha ra/ da ra da ra/104—408

gats+tsha gats+tsha/ bha ga bān/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā yal/ bha ga bān/ tu ru tu ru / a mo gha pad+me swā hā// //②na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki ①te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/tabya thā/ oṃ pad+me pad+me/ pad+ma dha ra/ bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dze/ tsa ra tsa ra/ brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ bi tsi tra dumo la dha ra ma ṇi ka na ⑤ka badz+ra/ bai ḍūr+ya lo kri ༷ta sha sgro'i ra/ ta ra ta ra gta rā ya/ bhā ⑨ga ba ti bā ra ṇa/ sgyu ru dhu ru / a mo gha bā sha haste/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka / a mun ta0/ a ba lo ki te/ ma hā bo dhi satā ba ra da pad+me yis na pad+ma gi ra/ dz+wa tshul dz+wa tsol/sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka a sgyi ṣe ka te/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā yardzi/ ba la ba la/ma hā be ga tsodha ra/ ba kri ⑩ta na ya na/ rda'i ka rā la ma hā te dza/ dha ra dha ra / bi bu ⑩la dza na ba ra da/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā yaX/ ma hā ba shu ba ti be ṣa dha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ bra ba ra purgya ⑥si bha ra/ su ga ta rgyu na sa ma durnyi/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te0/ khri dusha ra ma he shwa ra/ duṣ+ṭa da ma ka /ro dra pral 'ad ma ka /kro dha rā dza ma hā be ga cidha ra/ sa ma sa ma/ ma hwa'i dum thā ba ta /tsan dra srur+ya 6)a ti re ka bha dubha ma la ma la/ sasba ma la bho 0dha ga sasba ri ṣi ga na yisan ta ti/ ma hā ma he shwa rā 0ru dha ra/ a mi tā bha dudzi dunā lo kri ⑥ta dza bdu/ dak+ṣi ṇa tsan drwa lo kri skyita sha re'u/ ma tha ma tha/ sabra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa byas sna ta ga na 0bha na dza ka /ta ra ta ra/ ta ra ga ṇa sa ma 4)lo kri ta0/ nak+ṣa tra mā la sarba bisnan bī na 9sha na ka ra/ pā nir mi tre 8tsin+ta ma hā kā ru ṇi kā/ ba 104—409

ra ba ra/ bā ①ri puṇ+ḍi ②maṇa ḍa la/ sau mya mu kha/ ṣa ḍa cha'i ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ka /mi li mi li/ e dus 0ya tsarma ni ba dus na/ byā gh+ra tsa rmod ⑦ta ri ya/dha ra dha ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ tri ne tra tri shu la dha ra/ badz+ra dz+wa ⑧la dha ra/ a mo gha pā sha haste/ ya ma ba ru ṇa ku be ra rū pa dha ra nā ge na dra ru ⑨pā dha ra bi ma la/ bi shudhe ha/ sasba bā ba sha ⑩ma ka sab hub ra ṇa bi sho dha ku /sabra ki la bi sha na 8sha ka /ste lo kya ba sho ka ra sarba satā 'bi sho dha ka /bo dhi satā ba ra da/ sasba ta thā ga tā ④a rnyikhri te/ oṃ pad+ma bi 82 ṣi ta shudhe0/dhi ri dhi ri0/ a ba lo ki ya mān/ sa ma sa ma/ sarba kum me sā dha ya/ a mo gha bā sha hri 8da ya sidhe/ gu h+ye ni ba yisi ni ba ra da hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mo stu te swā hā // //( gyen mo rad na dutra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ma hā a mo gha ba ra dā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ pad+me so ṇi/ pad+ma dune tra pad+mo ge ④pad+ma dha re/ pad+ma ba ti/ pad+ma pri yes/ pad+ma gau ri/ pad+mā lipra ste/ pad+mā 6)sa na pra tiṣ+ṭha te0/ a ba lo ki twa pri ye ⑥ba ra de/ba ra dā yi ni pra si ta/ pra sā dha ya/ ku ru ku ru/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te ()ba ra te0 / hu hu sahu ru/ ba ro gi ni tsa la tsa la/ pad+ma bi bhū du'i ta/ pad+ma pri ye/bi tsi tra tra (stebi mān dha re/ bha ra bha ra/ si bha ra sma ra sa ma ya/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ma ma(ge/ sat+ya a rnyikhri 691 de bi a mo gha pā sha ba ra de hūṃ/ na mo stu te swā hā// //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo (1ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/104—410

ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ oṃ bha ga ba ti/ mā nyutre dza ne tri/ ba ra ba ra/ a ba lo ki ta ba ra de/ khyak+ṣi ri ni ③sla ba tu/ am ba i ba/ bi pū dhil klirti ka re/ pra ba ra bhu dze/ a mo gha pā sha ha ste swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ put+pa bi lo ki te/ gan dha sa re/ a mo gha dza ya ⑤si bha ra ṇi/ pad+ma byasam bhu rig/ ta ra ta ra/ mu di te r+ghaṃ laswā hā// //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ a mo gha ba ①sha hri yid ya/pad+me ni ba ra de dz+wa la dz+wa 0la/ bra sa ri ta pad+ma bhu dze swā hā// //oṃ a ba lo ki te⑩/ pad mi 8te/ ba ro tu ru tu ru hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ sasba ta thā ga tā tsos ba lo ki te/ a mo gha hri byad yan/ tsa ra tsa ra tsa ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sā dha ya hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa ⑩ya/ a mo gha pā sha ha ste swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ⑩a ba lo ki ta/ ma hā a mo gha dza ya dza ya swā hā// //tsom sasba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ta ()bā sha hri gu da ye/ dz+wa la dz+wa 0la/ dharma ⑥dhā tu gar+bhe/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ma hā pad+ma pad+ma bhu dze/ dha ra dha ra/ ma hā bā sha dha re / ba ra ba ra ba ra/ rasmi shasta ( nyes ha sra/ pra ti maṇa ḍi ta/ shā tso'i re/ta ra ta ra/ bi pu (nyel te dza dha re/ bha ra bha ra/ ṣaṭa pā ra mi tā ba ri pu ra ṇi / ka la ka la/ ma hā brarmi/ be ṣa dha re/ ma la ma la/ sarba tso'i pa ā ba ra ṇa ma ri )la ki bi tsog nā sha ne/ dhu ru dhu ru/ bo dhi satā/ bi shudhe bhu ru bhu ru/ma hā satā/ ba da phyis le/ ya ma ba ru ṇi0/ ku be ra ṇa (nyam skyi 9te/ hu ru hū (nyaru/ brah+ma/ bistu ma he shwa ra/ ku mā ra/ nan ti chake shwa ra/ ā+o shwa ra/104—411

ma he shwa re ①sba tra/ ban ti ban di ti na ma skyi ②te/ bi bi dha ma ṇi mo li dha ru re / a mi tā bha dzi dun/ mu duku ṭa dha re/ di bya ma ṇi ka na ⑤ka /badz+ra be+e ḍūr+ya / ma ra ka ta/ pad+ma rā ga /yin dra nī la di bya mu ka ti ka /a lo kri ⑥ta/sha rī ra/ shwe ta/ yarnyo pa r+pā ta dwa ⑦ra/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭa/ ma ṇa ḍi ta mā ⑧ma/tsan dra ra 'dzi ta/ pad+ma dha ra/ pad+ma ā sa na/ pad+ma bhu dza/ tri lo tsa na/tri shul dha ra bā sha dha re/ sarba ta thā ga ta a gi ṣi ga ta0/ sa ra sa ra sab pā ba pra sha ma na ka ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā hu ru hu ru/ sab ba ra dā ya ka bo dhi bo dhi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki te/ bo dhi maṇa ḍa/ a ba lo ki te/ lo ki (nyushā ra/ ma he shwa ra/ ma hā tsin ta ma ṇi dha ra/ bi shwa rū pa/ ma hā sau mya/ba dan ma hā kā ru ṇi kātso/ bud dha bu / bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bha ga bān tsosasba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki ta gar+bhe/ ma hā purgya 8te dza dha ra/ pra ba ra sirnyi ka ra sasba byā dhi ha ra/ sab duḥkhali/ pra mo tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi kā/ na mo 0stu te swā hā// // oṃ pad+ma pā ṇi/ tsa ra tsa ra pad+ma bhu dze/ dz+wa la dz+wa ⑩la/ snu ta tsosha ne/bhu ru bhu ru/ bi mo k+ṣa bhu yidze/ da ha da ha/ sab ma lan ⑩a mo gha pa ni 7bar de/ hūm̐ r+ghaṃ rna ra dud ha/ pā paṃ/ sha ma sha ma ni/ lo kod dutā ra ṇi/sa man+ta rathi cib ra de/ tu ru tu ru/ pra ba re a mo ghi dusidhe/ oṃ bhū sgu ba/na mo yistu te swā hā// //oṃ a mo gha a ba lo ki te 6)ma hā maṇ+ḍa tsol pad+me chasasba bo dhi satā yin ma hā ⑥ ki ta(ge/ bha ra bha ra/ sa man+ta a ba lo ki te/ a mo (nyagha ma hā pra rta/ be ṣa dha ra / ma hā kā ru ṇi kā bo sogedha ya/ bo dha ya/ ma hā bo dha ni/ bo dhi bo dhi/104—412

pad+ma bi bo dha ni/ sasba pā ba an dha kā ①ra/ pra sha ma ni/ sarba dur ga ②ti/bha ra ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi kāl/ ba tu ༷bi bi dha/ be shwa sridha ra/ sab ta thā ga ta gar+bhe/ hu ru hu ru/ a mo gha gar+bhe/ tu ru tu ru/ a mo gha ba dusha haste/mu ru mu ru/ bi mo k+ṣa bhu dze/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ sab ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe/ bha ra bha ra / sasba ta thā ga ta/ pa ri pu ra ṇi/ ha ra ha ra/ ta rgyar ya mān/ a ba lo ka ya/ pad+ma bhu dze/ ma ṇi ka na nika /bi bhu lak+ṣa ta/ bā 0hu/ da ma da ma/dur dran ta yinanatso/ ma hā bo dhi satā tibar da/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kātso/ sab de ba ga ṇa nam skyi ⑩ta/ ri 0k+ṣa ga ṇa/ sta bi ta/ sha ta sa ha sra tsan dra srur+yaX/a ti ga re'/ rasbyi yib ra bhā ⑥si ta/ ma hā ba shu ba ti/ bi shwa 0dha ra/ pa ra ma/ shurnye dusatwa/ a ba lo ki tidu/ lo tī dushā ra/ dub ra ma/ kā ru ṇi kā / maṇa ḍa le shwa ra/ su pra bud+dha/ ma hā pad+ma/ bhu dze shwa ra/ ma hā bibyā/ de ba 0shwa ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā bi mo k+ṣa/ maṇa ḍa la/dha ra sasba ta thā ga tā / gu h+ya/ mu dra chas ma a cidha ra/ ma hā beṅgā 0dha ra/ma hā ma ṇi/ mo li dha ra/ a mi tā ②bhas/ ma byaku ṭa dha ra/ sgyu ru dhu ru/sa man ta/ a ba lo ki te / lo ki ()shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ pā sha dha re shwa ra/pa ra ba ra/ pa ra ma ma hā mi tri / a ba lo ki ta/ sasba satā durā ga / sidha sid+dha ⑥sha4)/ ba ri pu ra ka /ma hā ba ra/ pra med/ na mo 0stu te swā hā// //oṃ bā zhe ra bī ra/ ma hā maṇa ḍa la/ bi shwa rū pa ṣa pa skyir mi tā/ pa ri pū ra ka /sabra bo rnyi satwadhi/ na ma skyi 8ta/ ba ra ma bi bu la/ bi mo k+ṣa dha reX/ma hā bā sha bi lo ki ta/ a mo gha bā sha dz+wa li ta/ ma hā dz+wa rgyal a ba lo ki ta/ma hā ma ṇi/ gis 'adha ra/ sa man+ta a ba bhā si ta/ dz+wa la dz+wa rgyal/ ma hā gi 104—413

bhā ①ra/ bi mo k+ṣa pā sha dha ra/ ba la po : ga /ā kur+sha ka /oṃ brah+ma rū pa/ma hā a mo gha pā sha /rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba satā ③bi lo ki ta/ dun mo hristu te ⑤swā hā// //oṃ bi burgya bi burgya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kāX/ ta ra ta ra/ ta ⑦ra ya/ ma rā ⑧ar+ṇa ⑨bapa ran/ ma hā bhu dza bi lo ka ya rgyu phaṭaswā hā// //oṃ a mo gha pa ⑩sha ma hā dā na pa hur mi tatso/ pa ri pu ra ya/ hūṃ da ra da ra / bi bi dha/ bi tse 28/ sasba satā0/ u pa bho ga /sasba ta thā ga tā tsom hā dā nā0/ pu dzā me ghi 0pra ba ta rdziya/ ta ra ta ra/ ta char ya/ ma hā pad+ma pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ a mo gha shrī (sprel/ si bha ra si bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shur+sā satā0/ pad+ma bi bhu du'i ta/ bhu dudza dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta/ a ba lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ ma hā biṅgāci/ oṃ byamo gha bi lo ki te/ ba ra ba ra/ drarjitso/ bibyā /ma hā ba la/ ba la ba la/ ma hā bo :bya/ ba la bo dhi ⑥ni hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha k+ṣa ni ta(nye/ sarba bo ta 0k+ṣa ma ṇi/ k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa ṇa/ ma hā me tri/ kā duru ṇa / sasba sa dhas/ bad byas la/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā / sab satā 0k+ṣa ma 0ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā a mo gha kā ru ṇa/ rgyu na sa mā dhi/ sarba bi mo k+ṣa / a pra kai pya ka /tsu ru tsu ru/ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ a mo gha ma hā pradzñā/ a ba bha (nyas/ s+pha ra ṇa/ bo 9rnyi/ pra sa ra pra sa ra / (nyaman+ta bu / a ba lo ki tā0/ bha ga bān pradzñā/ a ba lo ki te/ tsak+ṣu ṣe 6nyam hā pradzñā/ pra ra da pā 'aṇi/ ma hā pradzñā/ pad+ma dha ri ṇa/ bhu dze hūm̐ phaṭa 104wa 414

sasba thā bh+yo ṭ+wāṃ swā hā/ na maḥsab pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ o la ba dhe sasba ga ga na la ba rte ya swā hā/ na maḥsasba sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sasba ta thā 6)te bh+yaḥ/ sasba thā/o sasba sid dhe(mi/ dwa dha mi haṃ swā hā/ na maḥsab sa pa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ ā di t+yaḥswā hā/ so maḥswā hā/ i gā raḥswā hā / byudha swā hāḥbri ha sa pa tiḥswā hā/ shu kraḥswā hā/ sha ni sh+tsa raḥswā hā/ ra huḥswā hā/ ke tuḥswā hā/ krit+ta ①kyi ④su hā/ ro hi ṇi swā hā/ mri ⑤ga sha ri swā hā / a dra swā hā/ pu na ra ba su swā hā/ pu ṣ+pe swā hā/ a the yig swā hā/ ma gha phur ba laswā hā/ (kyepha la gu ṇi swā hā/ ud ta ra phal gu ni swā hā/ hi 6)sta ⑩swā hā/ tsi dra 0swa ste swā hā/ be shā kha swā hā/ a nu ra dha swā hā/ dza'i mu la swā hā / phur ba ṣa nye swā hā/ ud ta ra tsodha shra pa ṇa a gi dzi ta swā hā/ sha ta bha ṣi swā hā/ dha niṣ+ṭha swā hā/ pu ra bha ba pra ba dā udha ra pa dha swā hā/ re ba ti swā hā/a bh+ra ni swā hā/ bha na /geni 8swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta māṃ badz+ra tsā/oṃ a tsa la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sbo ṭa ya tra ka kha haṃ mi/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāka tsid badzā tsā/ badz+ra kā bā snyitsa rdu baṃ/ oṃ na maḥsabra ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sasba bha yi bi gi yite bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā khaṃ rak+ṣa/ ma hā ba li/ sarba ta thā ga te pu n+ya nir dza te r+ghaṃ hūṃ tra thā/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ ha ha hūṃ rdu phaṭa phaṭa/na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba sa ri pu ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ sarba si ka ri pa ri shudhe/ dharma te ga ga na sa mud ga te swā hā/ pa ri shudhe/ ma hā yā na pa ri wā re swā hā/ na ma g+ne ya —sgri kā ā+oṃ/ ta thā ga tā ā+oṃ haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na kā ya bā yi ka tsista bi sho dha na a bhi ṣiñtsa r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra shrī badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a gi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ sa ma 104—531

la / dhu na dhu na dhu na/ kai ka kai ka re/ ka si ni sa ma he te dharma a ba bhā sa ni/tsa ra tsa ra tsa ra/ ghu ghu te/ badz+ra mā lā dha ri/ sa ra sa ra sa ra/ kā lā tsā ra ṇi swā hā/ tabya thā/ badz+re badz+re badz+re/ ha na badz+re ni ①ha na badz+re/ khā da khā da khā da badzī 0ṇi/ ā+o ṭa sbo ṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ badz+re ṇa / i rda gra ha/hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gra sa gra sa gra sa/ pā ta ya pā ta ya pā ta ya/ dha me / dha dha me/ dhu dhu me/ ta ra ta ra ta ra/ ma hā ba ta ra ṇi/ ku te ku te mu ku te④/ badz+ra ku te swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ tā ba ne tā ba ne tā ba ne/ pra tā ba de / pra tā ba ne/ pra tā ba ne/ dhu ru me/ dhu ru ma⑤/ dhu ru me/ ma hā dhu ru me/ bud+dhā dhiṣ+ṭha te/ mu khe mu khe su mu khe/ swā la pra te sa mā dhi sa mā dhi gasgo/mā 6)na si/ phu ru phu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ bud+dhā ④mā (nyan si ke swā hā/ tabya thā/badz+re badz+re/ a sri skyita badz+re/ dz+wa li ta badz+re/ hu ta sha ni/ bhañdza bhañdza/ bhañdza bhañdza / dzam+bha 7dzam+bha/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ sasba duṣ+ṭa gra ha ṇi0/ rtsu hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gra sa gra sa gra sa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa/ ta ṭa ta ṭa ta ṭa/ mu ru mu ru mu ru/ da tsom da tsom da skom/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khu khu re/ khu khu re/khu khu re/ khu khu me/ khu khu me/ khu khu me/ sto ri gho ri gho ri/ badz+ra mā tson si/badz+ra hu ⑩ti/ phu ru phu ru phu ru/ gra sa gra sa gra sa/ sarba a ha tai shi rna7/su ru me/ mu mu le/ badz+ra pra ti pa ti/ sasba ba le phu (shes hā/ a lu ba (7la ni / tsu tsu re swā hā/ dza ye dza ye/ dza ya si bhā 'gyebe swā hā/ dza yod ta 0me swā hā / dza ya ba ra te 6 swā hā/ dza ya na dha re swā hā/ dza ya ma ni so swā hā/ dza ya badzā ya swā hā/ a dzi ta badzā ya swā hā/ ma hā badz+ra hu ta sha nā ya swā hā/ a mo gha badz+ra hastu ya swā hā/ tar+ya thā/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ ma hā dza ye/ mi li mi li/104wa 600

hi li mi li/ ti li dhiswā hā/ a ka ⑤khe/ ba ga khe na dzi te nā gā sa re/ na tī grili / dza hi li/ dza hi li ba te/ rtsa ḍi dul ba te swā hā/ ata te/ bta te/ nad te⑤/ ku nata teX/ ṭa ke/ e ḍa ke/ ta ta be/ tu ḍa be/ ra ṭa ke/lo ④le hu le/ hi li mi lirgya/ ti li/ shī le shī la/ a ṇ+ḍi ba ṇ+ḍidhi/ na 'o⑩/ku na ṇ+ḍi/ a ḍa ba ti/ ba ṇa ba khri7/ ka se ka se ka se/ pha se pha se pha se/ma hā pha se pha se swā hā/ na maḥsasba budhe 'abh+yaḥ/ sirgyu tu dha 8ra ṇi/ man+t+ra bā ⑫da 8ni swā hā/ ad te/ mad te/ ku ṭi/ pa ke/ pā ra ke/ pa 8ke ḍā/dra ma ti/ ta ra ma ti/ ṭu ḍa ma ḍi/ ṭu ḍa ma ḍi/ ṭu ḍa ṭu ma ṭi/ ṭu ḍa ṭu re / su re/ hi li/ mu le/ ti li ⑩ga hā/ da nad te'u/ de nad ḍi7/ma hā khod khebya/ rdza bha ne/ s+t+waṃ bha ne/ ṭa ḍi ṭa ṭa ne/ ma hā ṭa ṭa ne/ kud ṭa ne/ ma hā kud ṭa 0de/ dha ma dule tsa rma le swā hā// //dun mo bha ga bha ba te/ yid ṭi ḍa ṭā ④ya/ yin dra go mi si kā ya/ ā shā de / bā shā byinibya/ bā pa ni klu dule/ ka bi la mid te 3/ oṃ 0li snyu mid te 0swā hā/ nā rā ya ṇi/ pā rā ya ṇi/ ha ri tā li/ rku tā li/ i li mi ste(gye/ kyi li mi ti/zhu kyi li ti li mi sti swā hā/ ha ha/ hi hi/ hū chahū/ khā ra dum ra/ khā hi khā gnyi/ hūm̐ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// //(zhen maḥs mo ta bud dhā rna9/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ā+oṃ/ o ma ṇi dha ri brdzu ṇi ⑥ma hā pra ti sa re r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// //104—603
